_what_this_is: SPIKE v0 of the side-project 'concept image -> UE landscape' pipeline. This file is the LAYOUT BRIEF: terrain intent read from the concept image by a human (Claude, by eye), the step a vision model would automate later. Coordinates follow the project convention measured from recipes/alpine_8k.json placements: world metres, origin at map centre, +x east, +y SOUTH (image-north = -y).
source_kind: AI-generated fantasy concept art (Gemini). NOT a photograph; geometry is painterly and inconsistent. This brief encodes INTENT (layout, mood, biomes), not reconstruction.
